dict.string: RemoNook uses the camera when you take a photo to turn into notes or flashcards.
RemoNook opens photos you choose to add to notes or turn into notes and flashcards.
RemoNook saves images you choose to your photo library.
RemoNook uses the microphone for dictation and voice review of flashcards.
RemoNook finds and syncs with your other devices on this network when you turn on local sync.
